meta.name: add-imessage
meta.description: Add iMessage to NanoClaw — one channel, two backends. Local (this Mac's chat.db via the Chat SDK bridge; macOS + Full Disk Access) or Hosted iMessage (via photon.codes — native spectrum-ts with a device-login wizard; any OS, no Mac relay). Triggers on "add imessage", "connect imessage", "add photon", "imessage via photon", "native imessage".

copy.tagline: 让 NanoClaw 连接 iMessage 通道
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你在使用 NanoClaw 并希望接收 iMessage 消息。
copy.tagline_en: Connect iMessage to NanoClaw as a channel
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use NanoClaw and want to receive iMessage messages.

howto.what: Claude 把 iMessage 接入 NanoClaw:复制并注册适配器、安装依赖、构建测试,让你选本地或 Photon 远程模式,配置环境并重启,再确认你的手机号或邮箱作为对话身份。
howto.when: 当你说“add imessage”“connect imessage”等接入 iMessage 的请求时触发;也覆盖“add photon”等说法。

say.text: 帮我添加 iMessage 通道
say.note: Claude 会复制适配器并先问本地还是远程模式。

say.text: 用 Photon 远程连接 iMessage
say.note: 需要你提供 Photon 服务器地址和 API 密钥。
Claude 会注册适配器、配置环境并重启服务。

howto.what_en: Claude adds iMessage to NanoClaw: copies/registers the adapter, installs dependency, builds, asks local vs Photon mode, configures env, restarts, confirms your phone/email as identity.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say "add imessage", "connect imessage", "add photon", or similar iMessage channel requests.

say_en.note: Claude copies the adapter and asks local vs remote mode.
You'll need your Photon server URL and API key.
Claude registers the adapter, configures env, and restarts.
